Need for a nationwide ban on serving alcohol in sports complexes.
details:
Shri Sanjay Singh: I raise a matter of
urgent public importance regarding the need for a nationwide ban on the serving
and sale of alcohol in sports complexes, stadiums, golf courses and other
sports facilities frequently visited by children, youth, women and senior
citizens.? Sports infrastructure is created to promote health, discipline,
fitness and sportsmanship. Such places are meant for training young athletes
and providing a safe, family-friendly environment. The serving of alcohol
within these premises defeats their very purpose and often leads to nuisance,
indiscipline and safety concerns, making women, children and elderly visitors
uncomfortable. I had earlier raised this issue during Zero Hour With specific
reference to the Siri Fort Sports Complex, New Delhi, where liquor was being
served despite the regular presence of families and young sportspersons.
Following this, the licence for serving liquor was withdrawn. However, it has
been reported that alcohol continues to be sold illegally within the premises,
raising serious concerns about compliance and enforcement. This problem is not
limited to one complex but reflects a wider trend that requires a clear and
uniform national policy. I therefore urge the Government to prohibit the sale
and serving of alcohol in all sports facilities and ensure strict monitoring so
that these spaces remain safe, healthy and conducive to youth development.
(ENDS)
